During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operated an illegal '''clinic''' where they performed surgeries to alter the faces of criminals. The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] had made several attempts, through the efforts of [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stansun]], to shut down the clinic and download a list of the criminals operated on as well as their new faces.
